title: Onye A Họpụtara Ịnọchi Ya
intro: Onye sitere n'oge gara aga dị njikere ịbanye n'akụkọ ihe mere eme. Mgbe ụzọ ahụ dị ka ihe na-edoghị anya ma nwee obi abụọ gbasaa n'etiti ndị mmadụ, a họpụtara onye ohu a ka ọ buru ụzọ duzie ha. N'ịbụ onye nwere ibu ọrụ dị nsọ n'ubu ha, ha gara n'ihu idu ndú ebe ndị ọzọ na-ala azụ ịgbaso.
clues: A họpụtara m ka m soro onye amụma, m wee mụta ihe site n'amamihe ha.
Eguzoro m n'ihu Igbe ahụ mgbe nkwa nke Onye Nnọchiteanya anyị na-abịaru nso, ahụrụ m ka ndị mmadụ malitere inwe obi abụọ
E mere ka m guzoro n'ọnụ ihe e kwere ná nkwa ebe onye ndu anyị na-eru uju ma na-arịọ Allah maka anyị.
A họpụtara m ka m gaa n'ihu n'ọrụ e nyere onye ọzọ tupu mụ onwe m.
E nyere m ikike Chineke idu ndị mmadụ gaa ebe ha na-aga
Emechara m ihe ndị malitere tupu m, ndị mmadụ wee nata nkwenye nke nduzi m

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
